meaning: Clogged filter error (Waterwall models): water is not making it through the filter. On Rotary models the same code means high temperature in the heater.
causes: Temperature inside the dishwasher too hot (Rotary models)
diySteps: Waterwall models: clean the fine filter at the bottom of the dishwasher (see your user manual)
Rotary models: switch the power off at the circuit breaker for 30 seconds and back on, empty the dishwasher, fill the detergent drawer and start a Normal cycle
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the code returns after cleaning the filter (Waterwall) or the reset (Rotary), Samsung says to request service.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
